figma.description: CDS Web Checkbox (@coinbase/cds-web 9.29.0). CheckboxCell and CheckboxGroup are their own families.

notes.message: Checked takes the checked and indeterminate props, which CDS treats as one fill: filled = checked || indeterminate (Checkbox.tsx L78) picks the background and borderColor (L70-L71). With both set, the glyph is the checkmark (L131), so that pair draws as On and is not a value. CDS's own Code Connect makes checked and indeterminate two true/false variants (Checkbox.figma.ts L16-L18); the Contract follows Checkbox.tsx.

An indeterminate Checkbox's label stays fgMuted, as CDS renders it: Control colours the label fg when checked || indeterminate (Control.tsx L137), but Checkbox keeps indeterminate for itself (Checkbox.tsx L68) and passes Control only checked (L107). The Contract follows the render, not Control's intent.

Checkbox renders through Control, whose Interactable wraps the native input and the Box (Control.tsx L169-L201). The input covers it at opacity 0 (inputBaseCss, L40-L47), so the Interactable takes :hover and :active, and dims its children (Interactable.tsx L49-L64): the Box. Control never sets pressed, so [aria-pressed='true'] does not apply. readOnly disables the Interactable too (Control.tsx L177) and dims the label (L250): it draws as Disabled, so it is not an axis.

The focus ring is a 2px solid outline in bgPrimary, 1px outside the Control (outline-offset on :has(:focus-visible), Control.tsx L53-L59): the native input takes focus, not the Control. The Contract draws it as a 2px outside stroke with no gap. To-preview forces :focus-visible on every element, so its Focus page also draws checkboxCss's own ring on the Box (Checkbox.tsx L32-L37), which a focused Checkbox never shows: the Box is not focusable.

Interactable gives the Control a 1px border by default (borderWidth = 100, Interactable.tsx L209), transparent in every state (transparentWhileInactiveCss, L100-L108). In CSS that border makes the Control 22px square around the 20px Box; a Figma inside stroke takes no space, so the Control hugs the Box and the label sits 2px nearer.

Control aligns the label row to its top (alignItems flex-start, Control.tsx L243) and centres the Control in a box one body line high (height var(--lineHeight-body), L244), so the box lines up with the label's first line. That box has no element to anchor a layer on, so the Contract centres the Control on the row instead: the same for a one-line label, but a wrapped label's box sits mid-label in Figma.

The glyph sits in a motion div that fades and scales it in when filled and out when not (useMotionProps, Checkbox.tsx L84-L88; fadeIn and scaleUpS over moderate1, motion/checkbox.ts L6-L7). The Contract draws the frame it settles on, and the preview renderer renders that frame. Figma has no animation.

Without children, Control renders only the Interactable, with no label (Control.tsx L236), as the Custom Layout example does (_webExamples.mdx L35-L39). The Contract always draws the Label: no property can leave out the children the specimen renders, so an unlabelled Checkbox is the Control frame alone.

controlColor, background, borderColor, borderRadius, borderWidth, controlSize and elevation recolour or resize the Checkbox (Checkbox.tsx L69-L75; _webExamples.mdx L89-L117), and font sets the label's text style (Control.tsx L146). The Contract draws their defaults; they are not axes.

CDS's own Code Connect file imports from @coinbase/cds-web/controls (Checkbox.figma.ts L31), as the Contract does, and maps a "show label" boolean (L13) that the Contract has no property for (see properties.label).
